Lift dialogs show effective speed; saves synchronise units without rounding floors/second to three decimals. Omitted boarding and cabin dimensions match runtime defaults. The form retains bounded ranges/precision, so arbitrary valid JSON values may require JSON editing.
lifts[].regen_efficiency.validation: Finite numeric value, booleans rejected; numeric strings accepted; >= 0 and <= 1.
lifts[].regen_efficiency.limitations: Independent timing, envelope, single-car reservation, energy and deterministic reliability references cover their stated cases. Cabin geometry uses a max-dimension envelope, not swept clearance or stacked heights. No rated lift mass limit, multiple independent robots sharing a car, stochastic failures, mid-phase integration or calibrated energy model is established. Floor identity/location structure and all editor range/precision round trips remain under audit.
